coverage: Actual production engine subprocess with isolated secured per-user state; paired and scoped actors; shared SessionClient edit upload and hydrated queries.
Every action timestamp checked against independent integer nanosecond oracle; every value checked against independent shallow-ramp and plateau oracle.
Values-only uploads finalize uncommitted candidates, with no client-provided observed-evidence elevation.
Stale commit rejection, explicit rebase, fresh revisions, undo/redo, protected-edit rejection, distant unprotected edit success, and hard process restart/reopen.
All six explicit axis exports retain every action; ambiguous multi-axis export is rejected; standard exports omit internal authority and provenance fields.
Read-only upload rejection, cross-actor lease theft, wrong-project access, wrong offsets, overlapping chunks, conflicting retry bytes, and exact acknowledged retry.
Truncation, disconnect/resume, wrong advertised hash, four separately forged authority fields, revocation of an active bulk connection, and stale restart epochs.
Durable finalization and commit replay; all four cross-command request identity collision directions reject with RequestConflict.
